successful_attempt_metrics.caveat: Per successful attempt only; excludes failed/NO_AD attempts, initial preparation and manual pauses. Separately computed medians are not additive.

New NORMAL tab every attempt, never Incognito or replacement URL in a used tab
Actual rendered network ad detection; scroll; measured10seconds; owned closure verified; next item
No screenshot series/offline gallery or coding/documentation while a landing waits open
Loading/New Tab/technical error is not NO_AD
Up to3initial NO_AD then defer; one final attempt; REVIEW_REQUIRED afterwards; extra attempt only on fresh explicit authorization
Do not re-open approved links or reset history
Compact results; per-item reporting when requested; durable outbox/GET; no raw process-exit alerts
